rule: QUOTA-CFG-nnn is ONE namespace shared by both runtimes. This file is the single source, mirrored byte-identically into ab0t-quota-go/conformance/. Allocation is append-only; neither runtime allocates a code without adding it here in the same change. A code is a consumer-facing contract: it is what a consumer greps for, alerts on, and finds in the docs.

QUOTA-CFG-000.meaning: unspecified config error (the resolver's default when no specific code was assigned; assign a real code before shipping a new refusal)

QUOTA-CFG-001.meaning: Redis counter store undeclared (storage.redis_url absent or null with no QUOTA_REDIS_URL set) — local/byo_redis modes

QUOTA-CFG-002.meaning: quota-config.json missing (a missing file is a config error, never an empty config)

QUOTA-CFG-004.meaning: tier catalog undeclared (tiers key absent or null) — the library never invents policy

QUOTA-CFG-005.meaning: redis_url "memory://" refused on Python (no in-memory counter backend; bridge mode is the no-Redis answer). Go accepts memory:// as the explicit in-memory declaration — documented divergence D-5(b)

QUOTA-CFG-006.meaning: config schema violation (unknown/mistyped storage key, unknown engine_mode, non-array tiers) — ALL violations listed at once

QUOTA-CFG-007.meaning: bridge mode without its mesh API key (AB0T_MESH_API_KEY)

QUOTA-CFG-008.meaning: bridge mode without a service identity (service_name / AB0T_SERVICE_NAME)

QUOTA-CFG-009.meaning: DynamoDB region undeclared AND the AWS SDK chain resolved nothing (Go; Python defers region errors to the SDK today)

QUOTA-CFG-010.meaning: SNS region undeclared AND the AWS SDK chain resolved nothing (Go)

QUOTA-CFG-011.meaning: keyspace version regression: storage records a COMPLETED v2 migration (marker high_water=v2-final) but config declares v1-authoritative — a v1 engine would read orphaned keys and every counter would read zero. Not operator-overridable (ST-KEYSPACE-1)

QUOTA-CFG-012.meaning: brownfield keyspace orphaning: config declares keyspace_version 2 (dual off) but live v1 counter keys exist with no completed migration recorded — run the keyspace migration or declare keyspace_version 1 (ST-KEYSPACE-1)
